test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two Statements are given followed by Two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All athletes are boxers.

No boxer is a cook.

**Conclusions:**

I. No athlete is a cook.

II. No boxer is an athlete.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Either conclusion I or II follows.

solution:
Given Statements:

All athletes are boxers.

No boxer is a cook.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d8549d2652bb4e8c7b27be28a131c1acf19c3f03bbb11f6436ad4cbad34fe6e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No athlete is a cook - True (Because, All athletes are boxers and No boxer is a cook, it gives no Athletes is a cook).

II. No boxer is an athlete - False (Because, All athletes are boxers gives some Boxer are Athletes).

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
